content.text: {"interpretation":{"name":"TightenVariantFastenersLine4","scope":{"line":4,"station":null,"tool":"NR7","variant":null},"goal":"Bring the shared nutrunner NR7 to line 4's station and tighten, evaluate and record the fasteners of line 4's variant.","constraints":["Line 4 does not exist in the runtime plant state (only lines 1, 2 and 3 are listed), so its station and variant cannot be determined and no Recipe is proposed.","E1: NR7 must be reserved before use and released afterwards.","E2: transport-tool must be delegated to executor agvexecutor.","E3: NR7 must be at the station before configure-tool or tighten-fasteners.","E4: The tightening program must come from get-program, with no torque or tolerance literals.","E5: Every tightening must be evaluated against its program and recorded.","E6: Every tool-using Step depends on the reserve-tool Step for lease renewal.","E9: The 120 s lease must exceed every single tool-using Step."],"preference":"","priority":"normal","horizon":"current request; blocked until line 4 is defined in the plant state or the operator corrects the line number","requested_capabilities":[],"omit_services":[]},"recipe":null}
